notes.title: StarSide, redrawn
items: The title screen's station is redrawn: the spine with the hydroponics dome, solar wings, docking arms with shuttles tied up, and the big habitat ring on its spokes, lit by the sun and the giant.
Its beacons blink, windows come and go, and ships dock at the arms.

notes.title: Bigger windows
items: The game and launcher open at a size that suits your screen (they were tiny on high-res Mac screens). Window size has a new Auto setting.
Alt+Enter, F11 or Cmd+Ctrl+F switches fullscreen.

notes.title: Now on Mac
items: The launcher and the game now run on Macs as well as Windows.
Launcher 1.1.0: Windows players get a note to grab it, but 1.0.0 keeps working.

notes.title: A new front door
items: New title screen: the gas giant turning in the sky, Ketter and Verra in orbit, ships coming and going.
Continue shows your character, day, credits and where you left off.
Save slots show your character too.
The StarSide Launcher: install once, and it keeps the game up to date.

notes.title: Verra
items: A long-range drive for the ship opens Verra, a jungle ocean moon you can breathe on.
Lowtide Landing, the Greenwall and the Shallows to explore, and Ilo's trading post.
Proving Ground V-1, Warden Kesh and the Tide Mark.

notes.title: Ketter opened up
items: Ketter's fields, Proving Ground K-1 and the Rime Mark.
Handler ranks and Marks on the Kin tab.
